inputs.text: They’re using the 24 March 2026 parliamentary briefing and the SIU’s official stamp to make the alleged R20.56 million National Lotteries Commission scandal look like it’s about Terry Pheto. That feels less like transparency than a carefully managed spotlight: give the public one face to blame, while the wider funding mess—and whoever benefits from it—stays out of view. We should be asking why this story is being framed this way, not just accepting the frame.
